items.a: Yes. Lots of people do the first time. Someone will say hi at the door, and you can sit wherever you want.

items.q: Do I have to sing or pray out loud?
items.a: Never. Sit, stand, listen, or just be there. Nobody will put you on the spot.
About 40 minutes of worship, a short word from Scripture, a story from someone your age, time to pray or just be still, then snacks and hanging out.
Yes, babies included. There's a quiet corner in the back, and June is a night for all ages.
